title: /interrogate
line: Rerun candidate findings before they enter the report.

beats.caption: You ask Interrogate to check a local greeting change.
Two scripted seats check different inputs.
The real rerun keeps one failure and drops one claim.
The report gives you the one reproduced finding.

takeaway.title: Rerun the evidence
takeaway.line: Keep a finding when the command reproduces a failure that matters.

title.text: Interrogate asks several reviewers to test a change against its intent. This run uses two scripted seats on an isolated local fixture.

scene.text: One seat flags the shouted greeting and one flags the default greeting. Pi reruns both commands. The default greeting passes, so only the broken shout example reaches the report.

takeaway.text: The report shows the input, the output, and why the remaining failure breaks the intended behavior.
